Traditionally, PMC fighters and Scavs do not attack this oddball.

65ddcc9cfa85b9f17d0dfb07.name: Mark of The Unheard

However, it's still slightly more effective than shooting
65f05b9d39dab9e9ec049cfd.name: KOMZ Rusak reflex sight

Despite its disadvantages, variants of the M60 are still used in some military units. Manufactured by U.S. Ordnance.
661ceb1b9311543c7104149b.name: U.S. Ordnance M60E6 7.62x51 light machine gun

664a5428d5e33a713b622379.name: APOK Tactical Wasteland Gladius

664d3dd590294949fe2d81b7.desc: A key that unlocks the room located at the power station next to the ULTRA mall. Belonged to one of the Arena gladiators by the name "Grumpy".

At the same time, the drug is required to be manufacturable in handicraft conditions. The obtained substance allows to keep the CNS i
66507eabf5ddb0818b085b68.name: 2A2-(b-TG) stimulant injector

Mechanic built it from the blueprints of a certain someone named Mr. Kerman. Although the device doesn't allow you to connect to digital maps of the area, it can warn you of an impending mortar attack.
6655e35b6bc645cb7b059912.name: "The Eye" mortar strike signaling device

6656560053eaaa7a23349c86.name: Lega Medal

66572b3f6a723f7f005a066c.desc: A trophy for participating in Arena battles. Contains ammunition, weapon mods, or even weapons if you're lucky. Everything you need to make your enemies respect you. But first, you need to find a way to open this box.

66572c82ad599021091c6118.name: Killa figurine

AUG is known for good ergonomics, decent accuracy, low recoil and sufficient reliability. The rifle also stands out for its futuristic design. The A3 version features a bolt-catch button. Black version.
671b89f03d4217059b0c6a26.name: Steyr AUG A3 5.56x45 assault rifle (Black) Default

673cab3e03c6a20581028bc1.desc: The TRG M10 is a precision bolt-action sniper rifle chambered for the .338 Lapua Magnum cartridge. The TRG M10 is an extremely versatile platform: it easily converts from a proper long-range rifle to a more compact weapon. The rifle is designed to be used by army, police and various special forces of several countries. Manufactured by Sak
673cab3e03c6a20581028bc1.name: Sako TRG M10 .338 LM bolt-action sniper rifle

673cb212e695740be0047a46.desc: Standard chassis with a folding stock for the TRG M10 sniper rifle, manufactured by Sako.
673cb212e695740be0047a46.name: Sako TRG M10 chassis

673cb4054ff4aa8f86076f4a.desc: A .338 Lapua Magnum bolt assembly for the Sako TRG M10 sniper rifle.
673cb4054ff4aa8f86076f4a.name: Sako TRG M10 .338 LM bolt assembly

673cb491280680de5e02ff36.desc: A standard .338 Lapua Magnum receiver for the TRG M10 sniper rifle. Manufactured by Sako.
673cb491280680de5e02ff36.name: Sako TRG M10 .338 LM receiver

673cb51e093e0ea7fd0b8746.desc: A universal rail for mounting various sights on the TRG M10 sniper rifle. Manufactured by Sako.
673cb51e093e0ea7fd0b8746.name: Sako TRG M10 scope mount

673cb551093e0ea7fd0b874a.desc: A 23.5 inch (597mm) .338 Lapua Magnum barrel for the TRG M10 sniper rifle, manufactured by Sako.
673cb551093e0ea7fd0b874a.name: Sako TRG M10 .338 LM 23.5 inch barrel

673cb5d1280680de5e02ff3b.desc: A 15 inch long handguard assembly for the TRG M10 sniper rifle, equipped with a Finnish interface for mounting additional equipment. Manufactured by Sako.
673cb5d1280680de5e02ff3b.name: Sako TRG M10 15 inch handguard assembly

673cb81f5b1511adb10cd326.desc: A standard-issue padded grip for the TRG M10 sniper rifle, manufactured by Sako. Comes with a hex and torx key set for quick access.
673cb81f5b1511adb10cd326.name: Sako TRG M10 grip pad

673cbdfad0453ba50c0f76d6.desc: An 8-round .338 Lapua Magnum magazine for the TRG M10 sniper rifle, manufactured by Sako.
673cbdfad0453ba50c0f76d6.name: Sako TRG M10 .338 LM 8-round magazine

673dd5f73f92dc7e120d20a9.desc: A short length handguard rail for installing additional equipment on the TRG series sniper rifles. Manufactured by Sako.
673dd5f73f92dc7e120d20a9.name: Sako TRG short length rail

673dd617912f68467c0615b6.desc: A medium length handguard rail for installing additional equipment on the TRG series sniper rifles. Manufactured by Sako.
673dd617912f68467c0615b6.name: Sako TRG medium length rail

673ddbb567c759b3c90e5f76.desc: A rail cover for the TRG M10 sniper rifle buttstock. Manufactured by Sako.
673ddbb567c759b3c90e5f76.name: Sako TRG M10 rear hook

673f0a38259f5945d70e43a6.desc: The SL7i-BL sound suppressor, installed on compatible BoreLock muzzle brakes. Manufactured by Ase Utra.
673f0a38259f5945d70e43a6.name: Ase Utra SL7i-BL BoreLock .338 LM sound suppressor

673f0a9370a3ddcf0d0ee0b8.desc: A sound suppressor manufactured by PGM Precision, designed to fit .338 Lapua Magnum weapons.
673f0a9370a3ddcf0d0ee0b8.name: Sako TRG PGM Precision .338 LM sound suppressor

673f0b36536d64240f01acd6.desc: The Hekate DT .338 LM suppressor boasts great noise and flash reduction for large caliber rifles. Manufactured by CGS Group.
673f0b36536d64240f01acd6.name: CGS Hekate DT .338 LM sound suppressor

673f3ef1259f5945d70e43a8.desc: A muzzle brake manufactured by Ase Utra for .338 LM (8.6x70). Reduces recoil and counters the muzzle rise. The brake is threaded and compatible with BoreLock-type sound suppressors.
673f3ef1259f5945d70e43a8.name: Ase Utra BoreLock .338 LM muzzle brake

673f3f2f40aeca974e0b5c66.desc: A threading protection cap for Ase Utra BoreLock muzzle brakes.
673f3f2f40aeca974e0b5c66.name: Ase Utra BoreLock thread protector

673f3f5eef7545280c00f026.desc: A threading protection cap for the Sako TRG .338 LM rifle barrel.
673f3f5eef7545280c00f026.name: Sako TRG .338 LM thread protector

673f3f9840aeca974e0b5c68.desc: A .338 LM muzzle brake for the TRG sniper rifle. Manufactured by Coretac Solutions.
673f3f9840aeca974e0b5c68.name: Sako TRG Coretac CoreBrake .338 LM muzzle brake

673f4046259f5945d70e43ab.desc: A TRG .338 LM sniper rifle muzzle brake, manufactured by Sako.
673f4046259f5945d70e43ab.name: Sako TRG 22/42/M10 .338 LM muzzle brake

67405d760098dcb5940ea1a6.desc: A 20 inch (508mm) .338 Lapua Magnum barrel for the TRG M10 sniper rifle, manufactured by Sako.
67405d760098dcb5940ea1a6.name: Sako TRG M10 .338 LM 20 inch barrel

67405e3b83ac5c69ae025406.desc: A 27 inch (685mm) .338 Lapua Magnum barrel for the TRG M10 sniper rifle, manufactured by Sako.
67405e3b83ac5c69ae025406.name: Sako TRG M10 .338 LM 27 inch barrel

67405ef125beb509e8070276.desc: An 11 inch long handguard assembly for the TRG M10 sniper rifle, equipped with a Finnish interface for mounting additional equipment. Manufactured by Sako.
67405ef125beb509e8070276.name: Sako TRG M10 11 inch handguard assembly

67405fd0812f476fb2020066.desc: A 15 inch long handguard assembly for the TRG M10 sniper rifle, equipped with an M-LOK interface for mounting additional equipment. Manufactured by Sako.
67405fd0812f476fb2020066.name: Sako TRG M10 M-LOK 15 inch handguard assembly

674078c4a9c9adf0450d59f9.desc: This case contains several sealed boxes.
674078c4a9c9adf0450d59f9.name: Opened case

67408903268737ef6908d432.desc: A box containing contraband cargo from Peacekeeper. Opening it might not be a good idea.
67408903268737ef6908d432.name: Contraband box

67409848d0b2f8eb9b034db9.desc: The box is sealed to protect its contents. A multitool is required to open it.
67409848d0b2f8eb9b034db9.name: Sealed box

674098588466ebb03408b210.desc: This box can't hold much, but now you can see what's inside.
674098588466ebb03408b210.name: Opened box

6740987b89d5e1ddc603f4f0.desc: The contents are unknown, but you'll need a key to open it.
6740987b89d5e1ddc603f4f0.name: Locked case

67446fdd752be02c220f27b3.desc: A 72.5mm thermobaric assault rocket for the RShG-2 rocket launcher.
67446fdd752be02c220f27b3.name: ShG-2 assault rocket

67449b6c89d5e1ddc603f504.desc: A key suitable for opening most standard cases.
67449b6c89d5e1ddc603f504.name: Case key

67458730df3c1da90b0b052b.desc: A tactical backpack with a complex modular system. The arrangement of internal compartments and side straps makes the RUSH 100 a highly versatile backpack that can be adapted to any combat situation.
67458730df3c1da90b0b052b.name: 5.11 Tactical RUSH 100 backpack (Black)

67458794e21e5d724e066976.desc: A medium-size 3-day backpack designed for both military and tourist use. Manufactured by London Bridge Trading. MultiCam Alpine version.
67458794e21e5d724e066976.name: LBT-1476A 3Day Pack (MultiCam Alpine)

6745895717824b1ec20570a6.desc: 6B47 is an aramid helmet of Russian origin. As part of the Ratnik program, it is the new standard-issue helmet for most of the Russian Armed Forces. The 6B47 is similar to previous generation helmets such as the 6B7-1M and 6B27. It has equal protection but weighs slightly less, floats in water, and has mounting equipment for lights and ni
6745895717824b1ec20570a6.name: 6B47 Ratnik-BSh helmet (EMR Arctic cover)

674589d98dd67746010329e6.desc: An ultra-compact and lightweight chest rig for mobility and comfort. Manufactured by Spiritus Systems. MultiCam Alpine camouflage version, for all your winter LARP needs.
674589d98dd67746010329e6.name: Spiritus Systems Bank Robber chest rig (MultiCam Alpine)

67499a9669a58fceba104a41.desc: A package that the BTR driver was supposed to deliver to Prapor.
67499a9669a58fceba104a41.name: Package for Prapor

67499adbeca8acb2d2061634.desc: A delivery from outside the cordon that Prapor is waiting for. Judging by the weight, it feels like it's half-empty.
67499adbeca8acb2d2061634.name: Cargo for Prapor

67499b3eeca8acb2d2061636.desc: From the sounds of it, the case is filled with something heavy like OFZ shells or other munitions.
67499b3eeca8acb2d2061636.name: Lightkeeper's case

67499b9b909d2013670a5029.desc: The device is designed to suppress UAV guidance systems. Helps to reliably protect any facility from airborne attacks.
67499b9b909d2013670a5029.name: KOSA UAV electronic jamming device

67499d0eeca8acb2d2061639.desc: A letter from the BTR driver. Apparently, the information inside could put serious pressure on Skier.
67499d0eeca8acb2d2061639.name: Incriminating letter

67499d2c69a58fceba104a43.desc: From the sounds of it, the case is filled with something heavy like OFZ shells or other munitions.
67499d2c69a58fceba104a43.name: Lightkeeper's case

67499d4deca8acb2d206163b.desc: The device is designed to suppress UAV guidance systems. Helps to reliably protect any facility from airborne attacks.
67499d4deca8acb2d206163b.name: KOSA UAV electronic jamming device

6749c40822a2740bb408d066.desc: A PP-19-01 Vityaz 9x19 drum magazine with a 50-round capacity. Manufactured by F5 MFG.
6749c40822a2740bb408d066.name: PP-19-01 9x19 F5 MFG 50-round drum magazine

674d5e287075e056160e0176.desc: A polymer handguard for the Velociraptor assault rifle. A modified version of the Tapco AK handguard based on the Galil AR handguard, designed to be installed over the suppressor shroud, preventing possible injury to the shooter's hands during firing.
674d5e287075e056160e0176.name: Velociraptor polymer handguard

674d6121c09f69dfb201a888.desc: A special modification based on the AK assault rifle chambered in .300 Blackout caliber, manufactured by Aklys Defense. It replaces the standard barrel assembly with a modified integrally suppressed barrel, which allowed to achieve a significantly reduced sound signature.
674d6121c09f69dfb201a888.name: Aklys Defense Velociraptor .300 Blackout assault rifle

674d90b55704568fe60bc8f5.desc: As dangerous as the fish it's named after.
674d90b55704568fe60bc8f5.name: Akula push dagger

674d91ce6e862d5a95059ed6.desc: To celebrate Christmas and the New Year, Killa redesigned his body armor. The armor is now more noticeable, but Killa has never been one for cautious reconnaissance.
674d91ce6e862d5a95059ed6.name: 6B13 M assault armor (Christmas Edition)

674da107c512807d1a0e7436.desc: A comfortable and spacious backpack for its volume, it remained popular even in wartime. Judging by the attached antlers, this backpack used to belong to a hunter.
674da107c512807d1a0e7436.name: Mystery Ranch Terraframe backpack (Olive Drab)

674da9cf0cb4bcde7103c07b.desc: Someone has decorated the standard Terraframe model for Christmas. The weight hasn't changed much, but going into a raid has become somehow... more cheerful?
674da9cf0cb4bcde7103c07b.name: Mystery Ranch Terraframe backpack (Christmas Edition)

674fe57721a9aa6be6045b96.desc: A lightweight handguard from the Titan Quad Rail System for Saiga shotguns. Manufactured by Chaos.
674fe57721a9aa6be6045b96.name: SOK-12 Chaos Titan Quad Rail handguard

674fe89a4472d471fb0f07d8.desc: A handguard top rail for the Titan Quad Rail System, manufactured by Chaos.
674fe89a4472d471fb0f07d8.name: SOK-12 Chaos Titan Quad Rail handguard top cover

674fe8b9362ea1f88b0e278d.desc: A receiver top rail for the Titan Quad Rail System, manufactured by Chaos.
674fe8b9362ea1f88b0e278d.name: SOK-12 Chaos Titan receiver top rail

674fe8cf4472d471fb0f07df.desc: A rear sight modeled after the popular Heckler & Koch iron sights, manufactured by Chaos.
674fe8cf4472d471fb0f07df.name: Chaos HK Style rear sight

674fe8dd362ea1f88b0e2792.desc: A front sight modeled after the popular Heckler & Koch iron sights, manufactured by Chaos.
674fe8dd362ea1f88b0e2792.name: Chaos HK Style front sight

674fe8f6f34d761ab8020cc8.desc: The MD Arms 20-shell drum magazine for SOK-12 and compatible weapons, intended for use with 12/76 or 12/70 shells.
674fe8f6f34d761ab8020cc8.name: SOK-12 12ga MD Arms 20-round drum magazine

674fe9a75e51f1c47c04ec23.desc: A modification of the Saiga-12K smoothbore shotgun, enabling fully automatic fire. Hell of a beast.
674fe9a75e51f1c47c04ec23.name: Saiga-12K 12ga automatic shotgun

67506ca81f18589016006aa6.desc: Despite the fact that this model was manufactured in the 80s, the Soviet quality is still evident. The picture might not be as good as gen 2 or gen 3 night vision, but it's definitely worth its price.
67506ca81f18589016006aa6.name: PNV-57E night vision goggles

675307301f7c19a9780f2668.desc: The Battery Assist Device Lever for the AR-15 platform and compatibles. Allows to release the bolt into battery from the right side of the rifle, making it easier to operate the weapon for left-handed shooters. Manufactured by Magpul.
675307301f7c19a9780f2668.name: AR-15 Magpul B.A.D. Lever bolt release

67586af7036d7f3da60c3612.desc: The jar has been sealed either a few months or a few years ago. There's hardly anyone left in the city who would waste time making fresh pickles.
67586af7036d7f3da60c3612.name: Jar of pickles

67586b7e49c2fa592e0d8ed9.desc: Even during a military conflict, experienced warriors strive to celebrate the holiday. Olivier salad is the mainstay of the New Year's Eve table.
67586b7e49c2fa592e0d8ed9.name: Olivier salad box

67586bee39b1b82b0d0f9d06.desc: Even gasoline can fail in extreme cold. That is why you have to use something stronger outdoors.
67586bee39b1b82b0d0f9d06.name: Special 40-degree fuel

67586c61a0c49554ed0bb4a8.desc: A special product designed for preserving the cut Christmas trees.
67586c61a0c49554ed0bb4a8.name: SHYSHKA Christmas tree life extender

675956062f6ddfe8ff0e2806.desc: A version of the MTEK STRIKE helmet with extended modularity. MultiCam Alpine version.
675956062f6ddfe8ff0e2806.name: MTEK FLUX Ballistic helmet (MultiCam Alpine)

6759655674aa5e0825040d62.desc: A version of the MTEK STRIKE helmet with extended modularity. Olive Drab version.
6759655674aa5e0825040d62.name: MTEK FLUX Ballistic helmet (Olive Drab)

67597ceea35600b4c10cea86.desc: A lightweight ergonomic helmet manufactured by MTEK. Coyote version.
67597ceea35600b4c10cea86.name: MTEK STRIKE Ballistic helmet (Coyote)

67597d241d5a44f2f605df06.desc: A lightweight ergonomic helmet manufactured by MTEK. Coyote/MultiCam Arid version.
67597d241d5a44f2f605df06.name: MTEK STRIKE Ballistic helmet (Coyote/MultiCam Arid)

6759af0f9c8a538dd70bfae6.desc: The Maska-1 bulletproof protective helmet appeared in service in 1991 as a replacement for the "Sphere" helmet, designed for use by the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Russian Federation armed forces. The Maska-1SCh ("Mask-1 Shield") modification features a bulletproof steel faceshield to ensure maximum protection of the user's face.
6759af0f9c8a538dd70bfae6.name: Maska-1SCh bulletproof helmet (Christmas Edition)

6759bb94b8913ff13e049669.desc: A rare What You Seek poster. Only the most hardcore USEC operators can get it.
6759bb94b8913ff13e049669.name: What You Seek poster

6759e07e4ff23436160d7fed.desc: A rare I Bear Loot poster. Very few BEAR operators can get one of these.
6759e07e4ff23436160d7fed.name: I Bear Loot poster

6759e19a8367ee2b0c0f4b92.desc: A simple poster of a girl. Perfect for a rest area.
6759e19a8367ee2b0c0f4b92.name: Girl poster

6759e61067c8eb5cd10352f1.desc: A simple poster of a girl. A little weathered in some spots, but still pleasing to the eye.
6759e61067c8eb5cd10352f1.name: Girl poster

6759e6c39422e1708e0e9b81.desc: A simple poster of a girl. So simple that every man in Tarkov had probably seen it at least once.
6759e6c39422e1708e0e9b81.name: Girl poster

6759e7a44ff23436160d7ff5.desc: A simple poster of a girl. Not perfect condition, but it's doubtful you could find a better one.
6759e7a44ff23436160d7ff5.name: Girl poster

6759e8b1c3102563bd01c985.desc: A rare poster of a girl. It is said that someone pawned five gold teeth for one of these. Who they used to belong to is not stated.
6759e8b1c3102563bd01c985.name: Girl poster

6759e91d8367ee2b0c0f4b94.desc: A poster that has truly become legendary. Only a few people have one of these.
6759e91d8367ee2b0c0f4b94.name: Special girl poster

675a0288c3102563bd01c9c3.desc: A blatant advertisement for making money in the Arena. Many Tarkov citizens were tempted by the quick money, despite risking death.
675a0288c3102563bd01c9c3.name: Arena advertisement poster

675a046b8f547d6cae01922e.desc: A poster advertising making money in the Arena. Sure, you can make some quick cash, but you will most definitely die even quicker.
675a046b8f547d6cae01922e.name: Arena poster

675a04c01474133a0d0bb212.desc: A poster from the Arena. It depicts the at the time legendary gladiators. So many Scavs came to see them fight that there weren't enough seats in the stands. Nowadays, nobody even remembers who won.
675a04c01474133a0d0bb212.name: Bison vs Undertaker poster

675a04fdb8913ff13e0496bb.desc: A poster with Killa and Tagila as anime girls. If only they were real.
675a04fdb8913ff13e0496bb.name: Killa and Tagilla poster

675a06b84ff23436160d802f.desc: A poster of the avant-garde composer Alex Green. His music is multifaceted and unique, so much so that the world's leading media wrote about him. People used to pay huge sums of money to visit his concerts.
675a06b84ff23436160d802f.name: Alex Green poster

675a081c1474133a0d0bb214.desc: A rare poster of the movie which was never released. Director N. Tankovsky said in an interview that the story would be about a young security guard who began to notice mystical strange things going on in Tarkov.
675a081c1474133a0d0bb214.name: Things Sure Are Strange poster

675a0a91af26c56ee1090728.desc: At one point, the whole Tarkov was flooded with advertisements like this. But for some reason this particular poster is subtly different.
675a0a91af26c56ee1090728.name: TerraGroup Labs advertisement

675a0b8d4ff23436160d8031.desc: A rare poster. The concert was held overseas. Why were these posters put up all over Tarkov? No one knows to this day, but conspiracy theories are rampant.
675a0b8d4ff23436160d8031.name: Geneburn concert advertisement

675a0d2d57dd12f0260c4a31.desc: A regular poster of yet another movie from the director A. Bambetov.
675a0d2d57dd12f0260c4a31.name: Exodus poster

675a0eacf905bde03d0f8253.desc: A regular poster for the unreleased movie Den of Wolves. Nothing special, just a wolf.
675a0eacf905bde03d0f8253.name: Den of Wolves poster

675a0fbbb98bf391510bafcd.desc: An unknown artist tried to envision what a highway will look like in 2028. What is it: a flight of fancy or a subtle warning?
675a0fbbb98bf391510bafcd.name: Highway poster

675a125caf26c56ee109072a.desc: A poster for the movie Hell or Highwater. The big screens never ran it, but Tarkov still has enough of these posters left to use as decoration.
675a125caf26c56ee109072a.name: Hell or Highwater poster

675a191f67c8eb5cd1035305.desc: A poster for the action thriller Gunfight from the studio Battle Star. Years ago, cinemas used to have massive waiting lines for movie. Now all that's left are the posters. It's a nice reminder of the old days.
675a191f67c8eb5cd1035305.name: Gunfight poster

675a1a244ff23436160d8033.desc: The thriller Last Flight did not win any awards, but the box office collected a decent amount of cash. The director of the movie, Yulin Kontorsky, must have been overjoyed.
675a1a244ff23436160d8033.name: Last Flight poster

675a1af21474133a0d0bb216.desc: The studio Bubble Step did a pretty good job on their debut horror film Spooky Movie. Too bad they didn't have enough imagination for the title.
675a1af21474133a0d0bb216.name: Spooky Movie poster

675a1c129422e1708e0e9baa.desc: The movie Vasily from the legendary director Nikita Bayanov. It held the box office lead for 28 weeks, owing in no small part to its deep and unusual plot.
675a1c129422e1708e0e9baa.name: Vasily poster

675a1e502eac6c76e104ea1e.desc: The poster is not wordy, but straightforward. It'll look great at the front door. Or the exit door?
675a1e502eac6c76e104ea1e.name: RUN poster

675a1f5c1474133a0d0bb218.desc: The movie Sharpshooter never came out. A real shame. The poster's kinda stylish.
675a1f5c1474133a0d0bb218.name: Sharpshooter poster

675a202b6aaafea7210915fd.desc: A poster of the movie The Ambush. Although, in the end, the audience didn't see anything other than posters.
675a202b6aaafea7210915fd.name: The Ambush poster

675a20c83fb2de89670113b4.desc: A poster for the unreleased movie The Hunted. Something about this style reminds of... A sequel to another unreleased project?
675a20c83fb2de89670113b4.name: The Hunted poster

675a213ff905bde03d0f8255.desc: A poster of the unreleased movie USEC. It seems that this is how they wanted to fill the ranks of PMC operatives.
675a213ff905bde03d0f8255.name: USEC poster

675aaa003107dac10006332f.desc: Someone had sketched a hand-drawn diagram of the perimeter of the Federal Reserve military base in its northwestern part. According to the notes, there is a gap in the minefield that could be used for a safe exfil.
675aaa003107dac10006332f.name: Minefield map (Reserve)

675aaa8f7f3c962069072b27.desc: Someone was preparing to assault the water treatment plant and had marked out the optimal routes to bypass the minefields. One of the routes goes toward the bay. Looks like there's a safe exfil route from the coast.
675aaa8f7f3c962069072b27.name: Minefield map (Lighthouse)

675aaa9a3107dac100063331.desc: Someone has hand-drawn a diagram of the minefield next to the railroad in the nature reserve area. Apparently, you can safely exfil from Priozersk near the railroad bridge.
675aaa9a3107dac100063331.name: Minefield map (Woods)

675aaab74bca0b001d02f356.desc: It seems that "Voron" is some kind of cipher or code. If someone has manipulated the exfils from Customs, they must have left access only for their own. The question is, where are these exits?
675aaab74bca0b001d02f356.name: Note with code word Voron

675aaae1dcf102478202c537.desc: “Onyx”. If it's not a random scribble, then it's some kind of code. Perhaps one of the Scavs has found a new exfil route out of the city, but only allows access to their own. In a densely built environment, a reliable escape route must be underground.
675aaae1dcf102478202c537.name: Note with code word Onyx

675aaae75a3ab8372d0b02a7.desc: There's only one word on the note: “Adaptation”. Looks like a code word. If someone found a new exfil route out of the TerraGroup HQ area, they must have placed their men nearby to keep anyone from the outside from getting to the new exit. In that case, the code would help distinguish friend from foe.
675aaae75a3ab8372d0b02a7.name: Note with code word Adaptation

675aaaf674a7619a5304c233.desc: The word “Ark” hardly needs to be taken literally. It's more like a code word. There are quite a few locked doors under the Polikhim Factory, leading deeper into the catacombs. Perhaps someone will open the door for you if you know the code word.
675aaaf674a7619a5304c233.name: Note with code word Ark

675aab0d6b6addc02a08f097.desc: Someone wrote the word “Heartbeat” on a torn piece of paper. Sounds like one of Sanitar's weird pranks. Or perhaps a code word? If his men have their own exfil routes off Shoreline, they must be using a system of key phrases or signals. Maybe this note will make you look like one of their own.
675aab0d6b6addc02a08f097.name: Note with code word Heartbeat

675aadf3003bb2e826030996.desc: Usually these hats ring loudly with each head movement. Looks like someone got all the bells out of it beforehand.
675aadf3003bb2e826030996.name: Elf hat

675aae1c26dc64e17800fee6.desc: A Christmas hat with deer antlers. It won't protect you from gunshots, but it can distract your opponent for a split second. Sometimes that's all that matters.
675aae1c26dc64e17800fee6.name: Hat with antlers

675ac888803644528007b3f6.desc: In normal conditions, this balaclava would be too visible. But in winter it becomes essential, especially in rough terrain.
675ac888803644528007b3f6.name: Balaclava (White)

675dc9d37ae1a8792107ca96.desc: A special army dogtag with rubber sides serving the purpose of quickly identifying the wounded and deceased in combat. An indicator of the PMC operative's status.
675dc9d37ae1a8792107ca96.name: Dogtag BEAR

675dcb0545b1a2d108011b2b.desc: A special stainless steel army dogtag serving the purpose of quickly identifying the wounded and deceased in combat. Available only to the most experienced PMC operatives.
675dcb0545b1a2d108011b2b.name: Dogtag BEAR

675ea3d6312c0a5c4e04e317.desc: RSP-30 is a reactive signal cartridge for commanding and maintaining squad interaction. Multi-star rocket cartridges are used as flares.
675ea3d6312c0a5c4e04e317.name: RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Firework)

675f7acc4076a741a3061566.desc: A stack of documents with data on TerraGroup shipments. Contains reports on completed and planned shipments.
675f7acc4076a741a3061566.name: TerraGroup shipment report

675f7b168d28a25ec7007dbb.desc: It looks like this journal was used by the entire loading crew to mark all the loads that had already been completed. How could the foreman make any sense of this handwriting?
675f7b168d28a25ec7007dbb.name: Delivery crew report

675f7f224076a741a3061568.desc: It's hard to believe this wallet is anything special to Skier. It's just an old, shabby wallet. How has it not disintegrated yet?
675f7f224076a741a3061568.name: Skier's wallet

675f80d4fe1b59cf490d3527.desc: The box is sealed, but judging by the sounds inside, it contains the tools Mechanic was looking for.
675f80d4fe1b59cf490d3527.name: Box with upgraded tools

675ff11da6335de2280d492a.desc: A special modification based on the AK assault rifle chambered in .300 Blackout caliber, manufactured by Aklys Defense. It replaces the standard barrel assembly with a modified integrally suppressed barrel, which allowed to achieve a significantly reduced sound signature.
675ff11da6335de2280d492a.name: Aklys Defense Velociraptor .300 Blackout assault rifle Default

676008db84e242067d0dc4c9.desc: A secret TerraGroup invention that has fallen into the hands of the cultists.
676008db84e242067d0dc4c9.name: Secure container Kappa (Desecrated)

67600929bd0a0549d70993f6.desc: A spacious case for storing ballistic plates.
67600929bd0a0549d70993f6.name: Ballistic plate case

676009ddb623f3b8ba079419.desc: A pack of .50 AE Copper Solid ammo, 20 rounds.
676009ddb623f3b8ba079419.name: .50 AE Copper Solid ammo pack (20 pcs)

67600a0e84e242067d0dc4cd.name: .50 AE Hawk JSP ammo pack (20 pcs)

67600a42b32eb5d23e0eb459.desc: A box of 6.8x51mm SIG FMJ cartridges, 20 pieces.

67600a516f01341c9106ab4c.desc: A box of 6.8x51mm SIG Hybrid cartridges, 20 pieces.
67600a516f01341c9106ab4c.name: 6.8x51mm SIG Hybrid ammo pack (20 pcs)

676017fe8cfeeba9f707c8d6.desc: A receiver dust cover for the SOK-12 shotgun, modernized by Kiba Arms.
676017fe8cfeeba9f707c8d6.name: SOK-12 Kiba Arms Zombie Custom dust cover

676029a6bdead929d40bc368.desc: A children's mask stylized as a rooster. In the realities of Tarkov, it probably looks intimidating. Or not. As if there weren't enough mercs with cringy plastic skull masks already.
676029a6bdead929d40bc368.name: Rooster mask

676029ca2749de558a0b7e67.desc: It looks like this mask was taken from a warehouse with props for a play based on a G. Rodari story.
676029ca2749de558a0b7e67.name: Cipollino mask

676029e22749de558a0b7e69.desc: A mask depicting one of the best doctors of all time.
676029e22749de558a0b7e69.name: Aybolit mask

676029f997f19b78f00a0197.desc: These kinds of masks are often seen at kids' parties. But this one also fits an adult.
676029f997f19b78f00a0197.name: Fox mask

67602a0f97f19b78f00a0199.desc: A mask of someone who hates Christmas.
67602a0f97f19b78f00a0199.name: Grinch mask

67602a23c8e72a73250de737.desc: A common hare mask. It is unclear just who and why made a copy of this mask to fit an adult.
67602a23c8e72a73250de737.name: Hare mask

67602a39c8e72a73250de739.desc: A stargazer mask with a cap worn by astronomers from children's fairy tales.
67602a39c8e72a73250de739.name: Astronomer mask

6761492dc53ebe8c0f0a5efe.desc: An ambidextrous charging handle with two latches for the second generation of the MPX SMG. Manufactured by SIG Sauer.
6761492dc53ebe8c0f0a5efe.name: MPX GEN 2 ambidextrous charging handle

6761496fe2cf1419500357e9.desc: A brace stock for MPX. Manufactured by SB Tactical.
6761496fe2cf1419500357e9.name: SB Tactical MPX Pistol Stabilizing Brace

67614994e889e1972605d6bb.desc: A 4.75 inch ported barrel from the MPX-SD conversion kit designed for installation of the special suppressor. Manufactured by Ronin Arms.
67614994e889e1972605d6bb.name: MPX 9x19 Ronin Arms 4.75 inch Ported SD Barrel

676149a3e2cf1419500357eb.desc: A 6.75 inch ported barrel from the MPX-SD conversion kit designed for installation of the special suppressor. Manufactured by Ronin Arms.
676149a3e2cf1419500357eb.name: MPX 9x19 Ronin Arms 6.75 inch Ported SD Barrel

676149c5062e6212f5058c36.desc: An 8 inch suppressor from the MPX-SD conversion kit designed for installation over the custom ported barrel. Manufactured by Ronin Arms.
676149c5062e6212f5058c36.name: MPX 9x19 Ronin Arms 8 inch SD Suppressor

676149d8e889e1972605d6be.desc: A 12 inch suppressor from the MPX-SD conversion kit designed for installation over the custom ported barrel. Manufactured by Ronin Arms.
676149d8e889e1972605d6be.name: MPX 9x19 Ronin Arms 12 inch SD Suppressor

676149fbe2cf1419500357ee.desc: A 4 inch handguard for the first generation of the SIG Sauer MPX SMG.
676149fbe2cf1419500357ee.name: MPX GEN1 4 inch handguard

67614a0be889e1972605d6c0.desc: An 8 inch handguard for the first generation of the SIG Sauer MPX SMG.
67614a0be889e1972605d6c0.name: MPX GEN1 8 inch handguard

67614a225152c0eaed08ec86.desc: A 4 inch handguard for the second generation of the SIG Sauer MPX SMG equipped with an M-LOK interface for installation of additional devices and accessories.
67614a225152c0eaed08ec86.name: MPX GEN2 4 inch M-LOK handguard

67614a31062e6212f5058c38.desc: An 8 inch handguard for the second generation of the SIG Sauer MPX SMG equipped with an M-LOK interface for installation of additional devices and accessories.
67614a31062e6212f5058c38.name: MPX GEN2 8 inch M-LOK handguard

67614a3ce2cf1419500357f4.desc: A 6 inch handguard for the second generation of the SIG Sauer MPX SMG equipped with an M-LOK interface for installation of additional devices and accessories.
67614a3ce2cf1419500357f4.name: MPX GEN2 6 inch M-LOK handguard

67614b3ab8c060ebb204b106.desc: An armband by which the participants of the Khorovod can recognize each other. Without it, you cannot be part of the celebration.
67614b3ab8c060ebb204b106.name: Khorovod armband

67614b542eb91250020f2b86.desc: This armband will help demonstrate your status in Tarkov.
67614b542eb91250020f2b86.name: Armband (Prestige 1)

67614b6b47c71ea3d40256d7.desc: These armbands are only for the best of the best.
67614b6b47c71ea3d40256d7.name: Armband (Prestige 2)

676175789dcee773150c6925.desc: The Mark 5HD 5-25x56 riflescope is known for being a lighter and more efficient optic than other scopes in its class. Featuring optical glass, full multi-coated lenses and an advanced light management system, the scope offers low-glare, high-contrast imaging. Installed on 35mm ring mounts. Manufactured by Leupold. Flat Dark Earth version.
676175789dcee773150c6925.name: Leupold Mark 5HD 5-25x56mm 35mm riflescope (FDE)

6761759e7ee06333f108bf86.desc: A 35mm scope mount for installation on Picatinny rails. Manufactured by Leupold.
6761759e7ee06333f108bf86.name: Leupold Mark IMS 35mm ring scope mount

676175bb48fa5c377e06fc36.desc: A mount allows installation of Harris bipods on standard Picatinny handguards. Manufactured by Knight's Armament Company.
676175bb48fa5c377e06fc36.name: KAC MWS Bipod Adapter

6761763448fa5c377e06fc39.desc: A buttstock adapter for the AKMS automatic rifle. Allows to install Com-Spec and Mil-Spec buttstocks on the weapon. Made of durable anodized aluminum. Manufactured by FAB Defense.
6761763448fa5c377e06fc39.name: AKMS FAB Defense M4-AKMS P stock adapter

6761765f1f08ed5e8800b7a6.desc: A 100-round double drum magazine for the AR-15 platform weapons. Manufactured by Beta Company.
6761765f1f08ed5e8800b7a6.name: AR-15 5.56x45 Beta C-Mag 100-round drum magazine

676176a162e0497044079f46.desc: A 100-round double drum magazine for the UZI submachine gun. The magazine modification is equipped with a transparent plastic cover that allows to check the ammo count. Manufactured by Beta Company.
676176a162e0497044079f46.name: UZI 9x19 Beta C-Mag 100-round drum magazine

676176b762e0497044079f49.desc: A 30-round 9x19 magazine for the Beretta M9A3 pistol.
676176b762e0497044079f49.name: M9A3 9x19 CX4 30-round magazine

676176d362e0497044079f4c.desc: The FN SCAR-H (Special Operations Forces Combat Assault Rifle - Heavy) assault rifle chambered in 7.62x51 NATO rounds, was adopted by the US SOCOM as the Mk 17. Features a side-folding polymer stock and a free-floating, cold hammer-forged Mil-Spec barrel with hardchromed bore. Fully-ambidextrous operating controls instantly adapt the SCAR
676176d362e0497044079f4c.name: FN SCAR-H X-17 7.62x51 assault rifle

6761770e48fa5c377e06fc3c.desc: A 50-round 7.62x51 drum magazine for the AR-10 platform weapons. Manufactured by X Products.
6761770e48fa5c377e06fc3c.name: AR-10 7.62x51 X Products X-25 50-round drum magazine

676177591f08ed5e8800b7a9.desc: A 3 inch quad rail mount for the RFB rifle, allowing the installation of additional tactical equipment. Manufactured by Kel-Tec.
676177591f08ed5e8800b7a9.name: RFB Quad Rail 3 inch mount

6761777a1f08ed5e8800b7ac.desc: The lightweight ACE ARFX Skeleton Stock provides comfort, balance and aesthetics. Fits both the Mil-Spec and civilian M/AR platform. Manufactured by DoubleStar.
6761777a1f08ed5e8800b7ac.name: AR-15 DoubleStar ACE ARFX Skeleton Stock

6761779c48fa5c377e06fc3f.desc: A new polymer buttstock for the modern AK platform folding weapons. Manufactured by Kalashnikov Concern.
6761779c48fa5c377e06fc3f.name: AK AK-EVO stock

676177b09cfcc4c25b027446.desc: The Tactical Barrel Clamp is designed for mounting on tubular magazines and barrels with a diameter of 20-27 millimeters. Features a rail for attaching additional equipment. Manufactured by Toni System.
676177b09cfcc4c25b027446.name: Toni System Tactical Barrel Clamp

676177df1f08ed5e8800b7ae.desc: A combined kit consisting of a handguard and a milled gas tube designed to improve the performance of the PP-19-01 Vityaz and the Saiga-9 civilian carbine. The handguard is equipped with an M-LOK interface for installing additional equipment, and the gas tube has a picatinny rail for mounting sights and tactical units. Manufactured by Sur
676177df1f08ed5e8800b7ae.name: PP-19-01 Vityaz SAG MK1 M-LOK handguard with gas tube

67618651ac5e57c15709a417.desc: The TRG M10 is a precision bolt-action sniper rifle chambered for the .338 Lapua Magnum cartridge. The TRG M10 is an extremely versatile platform: it easily converts from a proper long-range rifle to a more compact weapon. The rifle is designed to be used by army, police and various special forces of several countries. Manufactured by Sak
67618651ac5e57c15709a417.name: Sako TRG M10 .338 LM bolt-action sniper rifle Default

6761a6ccd9bbb27ad703c48a.desc: A key to one of the rooms in an old house somewhere on the edge of the Priozersk forest. It is said that a person nicknamed Ogryzok used to trade in these parts. He used to sell rare goods including even a steady supply of tank batteries. Yet nothing had long been heard of Ogryzok, and no one knows where he had disappeared to.
6761a6ccd9bbb27ad703c48a.name: Old house room key

6761a6f90575f25e020816a4.desc: This key must have been used to lock one of the company offices located in the customs terminal area.
6761a6f90575f25e020816a4.name: Company director's room key

6762bf5bf34fb59c3d0b8247.desc: The PP-19-01, also known as "Vityaz", is a Russian submachine gun chambered in 9x19 developed in 2004 by Izhmash based on the AK platform. A standard-issue submachine gun in many law enforcement agencies and military units of the Russian Federation.
6762bf5bf34fb59c3d0b8247.name: PP-19-01 Vityaz 9x19 submachine gun Kiba

676385710ec76052ee01610b.desc: The SIG Sauer MPX submachine gun boasts an unprecedented operation speed in the familiar form factor of the AR platform. Short-stroke gas piston allows SIG MPX to use the full range of 9 mm ammunition without any adjustments to the gas valve. The full-sized mount provides the means of installing a wide range of scopes and sighting devices
676385710ec76052ee01610b.name: SIG MPX 9x19 submachine gun Gen.2 PDW

6764089eba9ecbb20a0052f4.desc: A modification of the Saiga-12K smoothbore shotgun, enabling fully automatic fire. Hell of a beast.
6764089eba9ecbb20a0052f4.name: Saiga-12K 12ga automatic shotgun Default

676bf44c5539167c3603e869.name: RShG-2 72.5mm rocket launcher

678f84bb9e85556ca60f0362.desc: Judging by this mask, the Labyrinth had severely affected Tagilla's mental state, making him even more unhinged and bloodthirsty. Who thought he could be any more crazy?
678f84bb9e85556ca60f0362.name: Tagilla's welding mask "ZABEY"

678fa929819ddc4c350c0317.desc: A massive handwheel removed from some kind of valve. It must have been used to regulate the water or gas supply in the Knossos underground facilities.
678fa929819ddc4c350c0317.name: Valve handwheel

679b944d597ba2ed120c3d3c.desc: There's no escape from the Minotaur's grasp. The only thing left to do is to take the last deep breath and hold on as long as possible.
679b944d597ba2ed120c3d3c.name: Last Breath poster

679b946f90622daf9708da6d.desc: Looking at this poster, you realize the sheer terror that the Minotaur's victims felt before they died.
679b946f90622daf9708da6d.name: Final Moment poster

679b94734e9ca6b3d80586a7.desc: This poster embodies the nature of the Minotaur. Brutality, thirst for murder, and blood. Rivers of blood.
679b94734e9ca6b3d80586a7.name: Taurus poster

679b9477708cfcb2060b9ade.desc: This poster shows the Minotaur being slain by a warrior from the Labyrinth. Very few people have witnessed such a scene with their own eyes.
679b9477708cfcb2060b9ade.name: Tark Souls poster

679b9716597ba2ed120c3d3f.desc: A worn office door key marked "Knossos LLC". Probably used to open utility rooms or other premises belonging to Knossos.
679b9716597ba2ed120c3d3f.name: Knossos LLC facility key

679b9819a2f2dd4da9023512.desc: A keycard to one of Knossos facilities. The design references the Minotaur mythos, but it's somewhat strange there are no Minotaur theme parks in Tarkov.
679b9819a2f2dd4da9023512.name: Labrys access keycard

679b98e429acd1f2f60985a3.desc: A chemical container with a thick, murky liquid inside. Only a lunatic like Sanitar would want to study something like this.
679b98e429acd1f2f60985a3.name: Container with suspicious substance

679b992329acd1f2f60985a5.desc: The documents are encrypted, but appear to contain research notes on some kind of technology or weapon. The records mention the name “Item 1156”.
679b992329acd1f2f60985a5.name: Labrys research notes

679b998180a165f7a40b4c2c.desc: A videotape with traces of blood and the words “Slaughter”. The owner of the tape hardly felt sympathy for his victims.
679b998180a165f7a40b4c2c.name: Slaughter videotape

679b9a1a4e4ed4b3b40ae5c2.desc: Meetings, facilities, and other notes from Knossos senior manager are noted in the diary. If you study them, you can get at least a rough summary of the company's facilities.
679b9a1a4e4ed4b3b40ae5c2.name: Knossos senior manager's diary

679b9aa490622daf9708da73.desc: The VPX Flash Storage Module (FSM) provides high-performance, high-capacity, solid-state SATA storage with AES-256 bit encryption using an Application Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC). Judging by the marking, it contains data on the focus group experiments and research.
679b9aa490622daf9708da73.name: VPX Flash Storage Module marked Group #3

679b9cce4e4ed4b3b40ae5c5.desc: A limited edition Tarko figurine. What's more strange: the pale skin or the nails stuck in his head? It looks like this poor guy has experienced the full spectrum of human pain.
679b9cce4e4ed4b3b40ae5c5.name: Nailhead figurine

679b9d43597ba2ed120c3d44.desc: A limited edition Tarko figurine. A creepy dude with a disfigured face and blades on his arm. Doing Obdolbos would give you nightmares.
679b9d43597ba2ed120c3d44.name: Petya Crooker figurine

679b9d4b3374fb14f40efe6d.desc: A limited edition Tarko figurine. Count Bloodsucker wouldn't have lasted more than a couple days in Tarkov. Sucking blood is cool and all, but does it work against flashbangs and .308?
679b9d4b3374fb14f40efe6d.name: Count Bloodsucker figurine

679b9d55708cfcb2060b9ae3.desc: A limited edition Tarko figurine. Looks like a monster with a disproportionately elongated head and a double mouth. Totally "Alien" (good one) to the Tarko universe.
679b9d55708cfcb2060b9ae3.name: Xenoalien figurine

679b9d6390622daf9708da76.desc: A limited edition Tarko figurine. This funny little character is wearing something like a pyramid on his head. A character like this could only exist in a fictional world, along with zombies and other monsters.
679b9d6390622daf9708da76.name: Pointy guy figurine

6878c143254146e6fd043756.desc: A custom muzzle brake for the AS VAL MOD.4.

6878c1c723c3173d7f06d926.desc: A custom muzzle device for the AS VAL MOD.4, installed on the MOD.4 handguard.
6878c1c723c3173d7f06d926.name: AS VAL 9x39 NB MOD.4 JailBrake muzzle device

68889451ad1e91bfa40db8fd.desc: One of the audio tapes used by Rus Post to record work calls from its couriers. This tape contains the first call from May 11.

688894da0bc983c31509f32a.desc: One of the audio tapes used by Rus Post to record work calls from its couriers. This tape contains the second call from May 11.

68889504f6192726ac07c66c.desc: One of the audio tapes used by Rus Post to record work calls from its couriers. This tape contains the third call from May 11.
68889504f6192726ac07c66c.name: Rus Post audio tape 11.05 / 003

688895322f6b5b76380e6af5.desc: An audio tape that somehow ended up in the safe at station 14-4 KORD. Either someone slipped it in unnoticed when the server room’s cooling system was activated, or they already knew what would happen.

6888965ac122cae7a20765fa.desc: This recording seems to capture one of Voevoda’s reflections on the causes of the Tarkov conflict.

688897992f6b5b76380e6af9.desc: The final recording of a TerraGroup scientist who locked himself in the Labyrinth observation room.

688897e094cca0a80b070aed.desc: An audio tape prepared by Kozlov for Anastasia. According to Kozlov’s letters, it contains irrefutable proof of the city administration’s ties to the local criminal underworld.

68889aab3fcaf13e48003ba7.name: USEC commander's audio tape labeled "For the USEC"

68889aca77aeb067290816f1.desc: A personal audio tape on which a USEC operative recorded a conversation with their commander during a rest stop.

68889c930b29b8032504f369.desc: A scope mount designed for the SVT-40. Manufactured by Addley Precision.

6889e4cd3ff7e9cfbc0c507c.desc: An unassuming thumb drive. Contains classified military data which was not taken out of the city in time. It's best to gather as many of these as you can. Just in case.

6889f1c4f7a5d7de7b089550.desc: A 30-round 5.7x28 magazine for the FN Five-seveN pistol. Manufactured by ProMag.
6889f1c4f7a5d7de7b089550.name: FN Five-seveN 5.7x28 Pro-Mag 30-round magazine

688a0b38467521f9080693a3.desc: A fiber optic red dot sight manufactured by MeproLight. Installed on a proprietary mount.
688a0b38467521f9080693a3.name: MeproLight Mepro M21 reflex sight

688a0bf28cdd409ce60911ce.desc: A Picatinny/Weaver quick-detach mount base for Mepro series red dot sights. Manufactured by MeproLight.
688a0bf28cdd409ce60911ce.name: MeproLight Mepro red dot mount

688b2dba67bf6fa26c07e918.desc: An ordinary toolbox with an unordinary color. Most of the stickers on it are inexistent in Tarkov. Someone has paid a hefty price to smuggle it from outside the cordon.
688b2dba67bf6fa26c07e918.name: Toolbox (Discord Version)

688b2e574172ca83e70cf868.desc: A unique armband for the most sociable operators.
688b2e574172ca83e70cf868.name: Armband (Purple)

688b3bfa1ed594eccd0c45ee.desc: A unique face mask with an unusual paint job. Guess someone should check their DMs.
688b3bfa1ed594eccd0c45ee.name: Atomic Defense CQCM ballistic mask (Ping)

688b44cb28bf8d85cd0ff108.desc: The SRO (Specialized Reflex Optic) is a rugged, compact reflex sight. It can be used as a primary or backup optic. Requires a compatible base to mount on Weaver-style rails. Manufactured by Trijicon.
688b44cb28bf8d85cd0ff108.name: Trijicon SRO reflex sight

688b4bd81cef2a61d0052738.desc: The SRO (Specialized Reflex Optic) is a rugged, compact reflex sight. It can be used as a primary or backup optic. Requires a compatible base to mount on Weaver-style rails. Manufactured by Trijicon. Flat Dark Earth version.
688b4bd81cef2a61d0052738.name: Trijicon SRO reflex sight (FDE)

688b54a11cef2a61d005273b.desc: A mount base for installation of RMR-type reflex sights on the Elcan SpecterDR scope.
688b54a11cef2a61d005273b.name: Elcan SpecterDR Mounting Plate for Trijicon

688b79b5eb234c75d900e050.desc: A 9A-91 handguard with a bottom rail for installation of foregrips. Manufactured by TTS System.

688b7b0d934c59b7bf0af0b7.desc: A compact lightweight rail for the TTS System handguard, designed for installation of small optics or tactical devices. Manufactured by TTS System.
688b7b0d934c59b7bf0af0b7.name: TTS System handguard top rail

688b7c1b0e99e554a90c0fb7.desc: A 2.5 inch rail that allows installation of additional equipment on the TTS System handguard. Manufactured by TTS System.
688b7c1b0e99e554a90c0fb7.name: TTS System 2.5 inch rail

688c86420e99e554a90c0fd6.desc: A custom handguard for the SR-3M assault rifle made on order from one of the well-known local operatives. Made out of aircraft-grade aluminum alloy and fitted with Zenit rails for installation of additional tactical equipment.
688c86420e99e554a90c0fd6.name: SR-3M Karden rail handguard

688c9df121038434840a1e06.desc: An adapter for installing 1913 Picatinny buttstocks, designed for AK-style assault rifles with 5.5mm pin folding stocks. Manufactured by JMac Customs.
688c9df121038434840a1e06.name: AK JMac Customs RSA-5.5 stock adapter

688cbdc341e2a57a8f0c1c6c.desc: A 1913 stock adapter, designed for installation on AK-series assault rifles. Manufactured by Samson Manufacturing.
688cbdc341e2a57a8f0c1c6c.name: AK Samson Rear Trunnion Folding Stock Adapter

689166b6c2d6fa42e7044756.desc: A variant of the Kalashnikov assault rifle designed for export to countries whose armies continue to use the 7.62x51 NATO (.308 Win) cartridge as their standard infantry small arms ammunition. Manufactured by Kalashnikov Group.
689166b6c2d6fa42e7044756.name: Kalashnikov AK-308 7.62x51 assault rifle

689166debd91cc17c109c753.desc: A standard-issue handguard for the AK-308 assault rifle. Manufactured by Kalashnikov Group.

68916701bd91cc17c109c758.desc: A 20-round 7.62x51 NATO magazine for the AK-308 assault rifle. Manufactured by Kalashnikov Group.
68916701bd91cc17c109c758.name: AK-308 7.62x51 20-round magazine

689167248f19dbc8190728ed.desc: A standard receiver dust cover with an integrated Picatinny rail for AK-308 assault rifles. Manufactured by Kalashnikov Group.

68916765fa628c6b9f0ed6f6.desc: A standard-issue removable rear sight base mount for the AK-308 assault rifle. Manufactured by Kalashnikov Group.

689167d79f03ec70cb0ea066.name: AK-308 7.62x51 flash hider

6891bb83d7502d512502d160.desc: A newspaper issue featuring an article on the escalating conflict in Tarkov.

689479a4a733b1602007e2eb.desc: A highly customizable modular plate carrier by Spiritus Systems, built for maximum comfort in combat. Wolf Grey version. This setup allows full freedom of movement while providing an ergonomic layout for ammunition and essential gear.
689479a4a733b1602007e2eb.name: Spiritus Systems LV-119 Plate Carrier (Black Division V1)

689479cb47e5acd1e10be986.desc: The fifth-generation FCPC plate carrier continues Ferro Concepts’ focus on lightweight, adaptable gear. In this version, the plate bags and carrier contour have been redesigned for improved comfort and mobility. Coyote Brown version. Equipped with two radios for communicating with both the assigned squad and HQ.
689479cb47e5acd1e10be986.name: Ferro Concepts FCPC V5 Plate Carrier (Black Division)

689479eb30cc5ba7be00f5ff.desc: A highly customizable modular plate carrier by Spiritus Systems, built for maximum comfort in combat. Black version. This setup is equipped with breaching charges and multiple GP pouches for maximum equipment flexibility.

68947ad3e4bf255d1b0ca75c.desc: The Load Sling by Mystery Ranch allows to carry heavy, irregularly shaped cargo. Its strap system secures items safely and reliably, while the external MOLLE straps provide versatile attachment points for smaller gear. This particular model is equipped with a spacious case offering extra protection.

68948a95d8f2b85fb705e2a6.desc: The 6B45 body armor, designed to protect personnel from shrapnel and small arms fire. Part of the Ratnik equipment system and has been in production since the 2010s as a replacement for the 6B43 model.

68948aebd8f2b85fb705e2b0.desc: A full plate carrier setup built on the 6B45 vest. This setup allows for convenient placement of essential combat medical supplies and communication equipment. EMR camouflage version.

6895bb82c4519957df062f82.desc: Radian Model 1 Full Auto, an AR-15 platform assault rifle chambered for 5.56x45 NATO. The rifle is positioned as a reliable, high-quality, and accurate system for professional and sporting use. Manufactured by Radian Weapons.

6895becad55f0ebf6a0c0311.desc: A precision CNC machined upper receiver for the AR-15 platform. Manufactured by Radian Weapons.

6895bf08e2d16810ba0bf43e.desc: An ambidextrous charging handle for the AR-15 platform. Manufactured by Radian Weapons.
6895bf08e2d16810ba0bf43e.name: AR-15 Radian Weapons Raptor-SD charging handle

6a3182b72fd891345e047eef.desc: Documentation issued to every new TerraGroup employee upon signing. It contains both useful information and the obligatory, mind-numbing office rules like how to chip in for a coworker's birthday gift. Can be found on: - Ground Zero - Streets of Tarkov - The Lab
6a3182b72fd891345e047eef.name: User documentation

6a3182dc6cd8de21cf0a3a7d.desc: Medical records containing research findings. Many of them are ethically questionable, yet remarkably successful in every other regard. Truth is in the eye of the beholder. Can be found on: - The Lab - Ground Zero - The Labyrinth
6a3182dc6cd8de21cf0a3a7d.name: Medical documents

6a31830dde69ceafd805afa0.desc: Operating manuals for TerraGroup equipment. Essential for anyone who'd rather not lose a few fingers or break machinery worth millions of dollars. Or for anyone looking to make a tidy profit. Can be found on: - Shoreline - Woods - Lighthouse
6a31830dde69ceafd805afa0.name: Technical documentation

6a3183258f113efdb7093622.desc: Classified information that somehow survived against all odds. Arguably the most valuable thing left in Tarkov. A unique document that can be used in place of any other document required for the Battle Pass. Available from the Expansion Hub.
6a3183258f113efdb7093622.name: Classified documents

6a33c17933cff6b88c08902e.desc: A mechanical key that unlocks either a utility room or one of the system administrators' offices.
6a33c17933cff6b88c08902e.name: Admin's key

6a35322b81d315afe1018ef3.desc: A traditional French baguette baked in full compliance with the 1993 French Bread Decree. Many TerraGroup employees were willing to take quite a detour on their way to work just to pick one up. It's easily recognized by the distinctive "Cocaoo_" stamp the baker marked on every loaf.
6a35322b81d315afe1018ef3.name: French bakery baguette

6a3532423ec9d7082a05d430.desc: A special edition, oversized can of GigaBeef, made to a traditional British recipe. Some say a meal of this quality even helps you think more clearly… though results may vary.

6a3bffbebc377285900b85cf.desc: A Japanese 5.56x45 assault rifle developed by Howa Machinery as the successor to the Type 89. Designed to meet modern battlefield requirements, it features improved ergonomics, ambidextrous controls, and enhanced reliability in harsh environments. Currently in service with the Japan Ground Self-Defense Force.
6a3bffbebc377285900b85cf.name: Howa Type 20 5.56x45 assault rifle

6a3ce9c28ce058e3a2059b15.desc: An upper receiver for the Type 20 assault rifle, manufactured by Howa Machinery. Features a top rail for installation of additional equipment.

6a3ce9e9123fa14cd00631e8.desc: A telescopic buttstock for the Type 20 assault rifle. Manufactured by Howa Machinery.

6a3cea0d277d1c54b5008e27.desc: A standard-issue polymer pistol grip for the Type 20 assault rifle, partly compatible with the AR-15 platform. Manufactured by Howa Machinery.
6a3cea0d277d1c54b5008e27.name: Type 20 pistol grip

6a3cea2b9768ff15af06d5e9.desc: A handguard for the Type 20 assault rifle equipped with an M-LOK interface for installation of additional devices and accessories. Manufactured by Howa Machinery.

6a3cea4494a96a17e00c4b69.desc: A 13 inch (330mm) barrel for Type 20 assault rifles chambered in 5.56x45 NATO ammo. Manufactured by Howa Machinery.

6a3cea5e94a96a17e00c4b6f.desc: An adjustable gas block designed for Type 20 assault rifles. Manufactured by Howa Machinery.

6a3cea96194a2625b40c863d.desc: A standard-issue 5.56x45 compensator for the Type 20 assault rifle. Manufactured by Howa Machinery.
6a3cea96194a2625b40c863d.name: Type 20 5.56x45 compensator

6a3ceab8194a2625b40c8641.desc: A 5.56x45/.223 sound suppressor designed to be installed on the compatible muzzle devices. Manufactured by Brugger & Thomet.

6a3ceacd8ce058e3a2059b28.desc: A removable flip-up rear sight for the Type 20 assault rifle. Manufactured by Howa Machinery.
6a3ceacd8ce058e3a2059b28.name: Type 20 flip-up rear sight

6a3ceadb6280cb85bc03f99a.desc: A removable flip-up front sight for the Type 20 assault rifle. Manufactured by Howa Machinery.
6a3ceadb6280cb85bc03f99a.name: Type 20 flip-up front sight

6a3ceaf01ac10a22850e295a.desc: A 30mm short scope ring mount manufactured by Howa Machinery.
6a3ceaf01ac10a22850e295a.name: Howa 30mm ring scope mount

6a3ceaff7047a606b90f5321.desc: A compact 30mm LPVO, manufactured in Japan by DEON Optical Design. Features a 1x magnification for close-quarters engagements and an 8x zoom range for accurate fire at extended distances.
6a3ceaff7047a606b90f5321.name: DEON March-F 1-8x24 Shorty 30mm riflescope

6a3cf2f17047a606b90f532e.desc: A standard-issue charging handle for the Type 20 assault rifle. Manufactured by Howa Machinery.
6a3cf2f17047a606b90f532e.name: Type 20 charging handle

6a3e92fdb0de53ae72082abb.desc: An angled charging handle for the SCAR series assault rifles, manufactured by Sure Cycle.

6a3e936964b1d1fcc50ebbff.desc: The BCD Lever for the SCAR platform and compatibles. Allows to release the bolt into battery from the right side of the rifle. Manufactured by Parker Mountain Machine.
6a3e936964b1d1fcc50ebbff.name: FN SCAR PMM BCD Lever bolt release

6a4263c3bf5f5f7f9a0ee828.desc: Who would you rather run into in the woods: a bear or a BEAR?

6a4264160a2dca942e08292d.desc: A poster for fatalists and pyromaniacs alike.

6a42661705016139300b2085.desc: A Chinese 5.8x42mm intermediate tracer cartridge developed for the QBZ-95 family of service rifles.
6a42661705016139300b2085.name: 5.8x42mm DBX95

6a42662fcb506840dd053827.desc: An improved Chinese 5.8x42mm intermediate armor-piercing cartridge developed for the modern 5.8x42mm weapon platforms.
6a42662fcb506840dd053827.name: 5.8x42mm DVC12

6a426637ddc63098d100ae67.desc: An improved Chinese 5.8x42mm intermediate armor-piercing tracer cartridge developed for the modern 5.8x42mm weapon platforms.

6a426fbe99757acd420f64b0.desc: The local street fighters are there to greet anyone who lays eyes on this poster.

6a461aed7391ab085a093760.desc: A Black Division dogtag. This one clearly belonged to a newcomer in their ranks.
6a461aed7391ab085a093760.name: BD dogtag •| Ferrum

6a461bf82b2264dbe10d0ee6.desc: A Black Division dogtag. Its unusual color and the growing number of markings suggest its owner was a formidable opponent. Then again, you probably figured that out yourself.
6a461bf82b2264dbe10d0ee6.name: BD dogtag •|| Green

6a461c41ec88c6b9a509fb17.desc: A Black Division dogtag taken from one of their most formidable fighters. A true battle trophy that's sure to be highly prized.
6a461c41ec88c6b9a509fb17.name: BD dogtag •||| Red

6a4ce086b5644e9f0a08d08a.desc: A miniature model of the transport aircraft used by the U.S. Marine Corps. Rumor has it that one of the USEC operatives in Tarkov previously served in the USMC and flew aboard this very aircraft.
6a4ce086b5644e9f0a08d08a.name: LM KC-130 model aircraft

6a4fa628b4831242f306e8cd.desc: A heavy transport crate with no identifying markings. 6a4ff1e23e95f68a650fcb13.desc: Once assembled, the icebreaker brings back even more memories. It might even bring a tear to your eye, but that could be the tear gas. Press the secret button on the model to make it emit green smoke.
6a4ff1e23e95f68a650fcb13.name: Icebreaker model

6a55f339fe4be93a04090acc.desc: This folder contains fragments of data recovered from the rugged laptop stolen from one of the TerraGroup facilities.

6a5615d8a166c11ce900e1a6.name: Safariland Liberator HP 2.0 Hearing Protection Headset (Desert Tiger Stripe)

6a5629dfbd83cb160606681c.desc: The M2 vest is created with the use of the best experience of Russian special forces operators. The versatility of the system makes it possible to use this vest both when carrying out urban tasks and when performing tasks on rough terrain. Manufactured by ANA Tactical. A-TACS iX camouflage version.
6a5629dfbd83cb160606681c.name: ANA Tactical M2 plate carrier (A-TACS iX)

6a562a1f4281184d32097600.desc: The M2 vest is created with the use of the best experience of Russian special forces operators. 6a565aede592c037e10a3c16.desc: The Thunderbolt fixed chest rig, containing all the basic utility pouches you'd need. Manufactured by Direct Action. A custom version in PenCott BadLands camouflage customized by one of the Arena fighters.

6a565b5f9ec10bc6e30cdf46.desc: The Thunderbolt fixed chest rig, containing all the basic utility pouches you'd need. Manufactured by Direct Action. PenCott WildWood camouflage version.

6a566628d1d0c640e6034ebb.desc: The Razor electronic ear muffs feature an ultra low-profile design and a rubberized coating for added durability and comfort, also providing optimal hearing protection. Manufactured by Walker's. The carbon fiber is a fake print, by the way.

6a56665a3b664c6b2c0d784a.desc: The Razor electronic ear muffs feature an ultra low-profile design and a rubberized coating for added durability and comfort, also providing optimal hearing protection. Manufactured by Walker's. Woodland camouflage version.
6a56665a3b664c6b2c0d784a.name: Walker's Razor Slim headset (Woodland)

6a567ae55cbe811cbe0136a8.desc: The AirFrame ballistic helmet sets the standards in protection, comfort, and modularity. The unique overlapping shell design of the AirFrame creates an integrated vent that provides passive cooling and can reduce the damaging effects of explosive blast waves. Highly modular. Manufactured by Crye Precision. One of the Arena fighters tried
6a567ae55cbe811cbe0136a8.name: Crye Precision AirFrame helmet (Botched)

6a568340263768e2ae0c9696.desc: The Titan Aramid ballistic helmet in the form factor copying the Crye Precision AirFrame helmet. EMR camouflage version.
6a568340263768e2ae0c9696.name: Atlant Armour Titan Aramid helmet (EMR)

6a568dda1d89fcfb35010389.desc: A lightweight ergonomic helmet manufactured by MTEK. Comes with a set of stickers imitating a carbon fiber look.
6a568dda1d89fcfb35010389.name: MTEK STRIKE Ballistic helmet (Carbon Fiber)

6a576f2105af50743903b74c.desc: The M1 vest is created with the use of the best experience of Russian special forces operators. Manufactured by ANA Tactical. EMR camouflage version.
6a576f2105af50743903b74c.name: ANA Tactical M1 plate carrier (EMR)

6a5f8182948bfbabc30b0659.desc: A Japanese 5.56x45 assault rifle developed by Howa Machinery as the successor to the Type 89. 6a5f9c49b8281c31a1062aea.desc: Judging by the label attached to this otherwise ordinary SSD, its contents have yet to be examined by Black Division operatives. Once evaluated and sorted, storage devices like this are assigned to one of the evacuation categories.
